steps.code:
# We have shovel (4766), flag (53954), and radiocarbon meter (60834) in inventory.
# Let's teleport to dig site 1, 2, 3 and inspect/excavate/date artifacts!

SHOVEL_UUID = 4766
FLAG_UUID = 53954
METER_UUID = 60834

def inspect_site(site_name):
    print(f"=== {site_name} ===")
    api.teleport_to_location(site_name)
    obs = api.observe_world()
    print("Loc:", obs["agentLocation"])
    nearby = [o for o in api.list_nearby_objects() if o["name"] not in ("grass", "agent", "shovel", "flag", "radiocarbon meter")]
    for o in nearby:
        print("  Nearby:", o)
    acc = [o for o in api.list_accessible_objects() if o["name"] not in ("grass", "agent", "shovel", "flag", "radiocarbon meter")]
    for o in acc:
        print("  Acc:", o)
    return nearby, acc

inspect_site("dig site 1")

# In dig site 1 (9, 11):
# Soil 50423 is distance 1 east (10, 11).
# Soil 34833 is distance 2 east (11, 11).
# Sign 37350 is distance 2 north-east (10, 10).
# Let's rotate east, use shovel on soil 50423, see what appears, date it, move east to (10, 11), use shovel on soil 34833, date any artifacts!

def excavate_and_date_here():
    for o in api.list_accessible_objects():
        if o["name"] in ("soil", "hole") or "soil" in o["name"]:
            print(f"Using shovel on {o}:")
            r = api.use_object(SHOVEL_UUID, o["uuid"])
            obs = api.observe_world()
            print("  msg:", obs.get("lastActionMessage"), "| ext:", obs.get("extended_action_message"))
    # Now check accessible objects again for any artifacts or holes or objects in holes
    acc = [o for o in api.list_accessible_objects() if o["name"] not in ("grass", "agent", "shovel", "flag", "radiocarbon meter", "soil")]
    print("Accessible after shovel:", acc)
    for o in acc:
        if o["name"] not in ("sign", "plant", "plant (generic)", "tree (big) trunk", "tree (big) leaves", "table"):
            print(f"Using radiocarbon meter on {o}:")
            r = api.use_object(METER_UUID, o["uuid"])
            obs = api.observe_world()
            print("  msg:", obs.get("lastActionMessage"), "| ext:", obs.get("extended_action_message"))

api.rotate_direction("east")
excavate_and_date_here()

# Move east to (10, 11)
api.move_direction("east")
obs = api.observe_world()
print("At:", obs["agentLocation"])
# Also check sign to the north (10, 10)
api.rotate_direction("north")
for o in api.list_accessible_objects():
    if o["name"] == "sign":
        r = api.read_object(o["uuid"])
        obs = api.observe_world()
        print("Read sign:", obs.get("lastActionMessage"), "| ext:", obs.get("extended_action_message"))

api.rotate_direction("east")
excavate_and_date_here()

# Check if there is any more soil nearby at dig site 1
nearby_soil = api.list_nearby_objects(query="soil")
print("Remaining nearby soil at site 1:", nearby_soil)

# Great! At Dig Site 1, we excavated both soil tiles (50423 and 34833) and found ancient artifact 14424 (890,000 years old).
# Now let's inspect and excavate Dig Site 2 and Dig Site 3!

def process_site(site_name):
    print(f"=== {site_name} ===")
    api.teleport_to_location(site_name)
    obs = api.observe_world()
    print("Loc:", obs["agentLocation"])
    nearby = [o for o in api.list_nearby_objects() if o["name"] not in ("grass", "agent", "shovel", "flag", "radiocarbon meter", "dirt")]
    for o in nearby:
        print("  Nearby:", o)
    return nearby

nearby2 = process_site("dig site 2")
nearby3 = process_site("dig site 3")

steps.code:
# We are currently at dig site 3 (11, 19) facing east!
# Let's excavate all soil at dig site 3 and dig site 2, date all artifacts, and see which site has the oldest artifact!
# Then we can place the red flag beside the sign of the dig site with the oldest artifact!

def dig_and_date_accessible():
    for o in api.list_accessible_objects():
        if o["name"] == "soil":
            print(f"Digging {o}:")
            api.use_object(SHOVEL_UUID, o["uuid"])
            obs = api.observe_world()
            print("  ->", obs.get("lastActionMessage"))
    for o in api.list_accessible_objects():
        if "artifact" in o["name"]:
            print(f"Dating {o}:")
            api.use_object(METER_UUID, o["uuid"])
            obs = api.observe_world()
            print("  ->", obs.get("lastActionMessage"))

print("--- Excavating Dig Site 3 ---")
# Currently at (11, 19) facing east. Soil 56583 is at (12, 19) (east, dist 1). Soil 776 is at (12, 20) (south-east, dist 2). Hole 29924 is at (14, 19) (east, dist 3).
dig_and_date_accessible()
# Move east to (12, 19)
api.move_direction("east")
dig_and_date_accessible()
# Rotate south to face (12, 20) where soil 776 is
api.rotate_direction("south")
dig_and_date_accessible()
# Move south to (12, 20) and check all around just in case
api.move_direction("south")
for d in ["north", "east", "south", "west"]:
    api.rotate_direction(d)
    dig_and_date_accessible()
# Also check if hole 29924 at (14, 19) has anything or if there's more soil nearby
print("Site 3 remaining soil:", api.list_nearby_objects(query="soil"))
print("Site 3 nearby artifacts:", api.list_nearby_objects(query="artifact"))

print("--- Excavating Dig Site 2 ---")
api.teleport_to_location("dig site 2")
# At (19, 14) facing east. Soil 56191 is at (20, 14) (east, dist 1). Soil 33841 is at (20, 15) (south-east, dist 2).
dig_and_date_accessible()
api.move_direction("east")
dig_and_date_accessible()
api.rotate_direction("south")
dig_and_date_accessible()
api.move_direction("south")
for d in ["north", "east", "south", "west"]:
    api.rotate_direction(d)
    dig_and_date_accessible()
print("Site 2 remaining soil:", api.list_nearby_objects(query="soil"))
print("Site 2 nearby artifacts:", api.list_nearby_objects(query="artifact"))

steps.title: The episode reaches its success condition.
steps.code:
# Summary of artifact ages:
# Dig Site 1: ancient artifact 14424 -> 890,000 years
# Dig Site 2: ancient artifact 1787 -> 725,000 years
# Dig Site 3: ancient artifact 24902 -> 150,000 years
# Oldest artifact is at Dig Site 1 (890,000 years)!
# Goal: "place the red flag beside the sign of the dig site with the oldest artifact."
# At Dig Site 1, the sign (uuid 37350) is at (10, 10).
# Let's teleport to dig site 1 (9, 11), move north to (9, 10) which is directly beside the sign (10, 10), and drop the flag!
# Let's check check_success() after dropping, and if not completed, try other adjacent tiles to (10, 10) or put_object!

api.write_evidence("site_1_age_years", 890000)
api.write_evidence("site_2_age_years", 725000)
api.write_evidence("site_3_age_years", 150000)
api.write_evidence("oldest_site", "dig site 1")

api.teleport_to_location("dig site 1")
# We are at (9, 11). Move north to (9, 10), which is west of the sign at (10, 10).
api.move_direction("north")
api.rotate_direction("east")
print("At (9, 10) facing east:", api.observe_world()["agentLocation"])
print("Accessible:", api.list_accessible_objects())

res = api.drop_object(FLAG_UUID)
print("Drop flag at (9, 10):", api.observe_world().get("lastActionMessage"))
s = api.check_success()
print("Check success:", s)

if not s.get("completedSuccessfully"):
    # Try picking it up and placing it at (10, 9), (11, 10), or (10, 11)
    api.pickup_object(FLAG_UUID)
    api.move_direction("north")
    api.move_direction("east") # (10, 9)
    api.drop_object(FLAG_UUID)
    s = api.check_success()
    print("Check success at (10, 9):", s)

if not s.get("completedSuccessfully"):
    api.pickup_object(FLAG_UUID)
    api.move_direction("east")
    api.move_direction("south") # (11, 10)
    api.drop_object(FLAG_UUID)
    s = api.check_success()
    print("Check success at (11, 10):", s)

print("Final check_success:", api.check_success())
